The hall

A hall for events and workshops,
8 metres high.

The whole ground floor is one event space.

The studios · a partnership, not just rent

Four studios upstairs,
for the people who make events.

On the deck above the floor:
four studios of 20 m², our own office beside them,
and a shared kitchen and lunch terrace at the head of the stair.
You have your own place to work,
and you use part of the space, help it run well,
and we make more events together.
That is the deal: a partnership, not just rent.

  • Curtains for walls. 3 m high, 4 m of ceiling, the floor 4 m below you.
  • Energy, cooling, heating, wifi and water are in the €600. No utility bill arrives.
  • Your studio is cleaned every week, by somebody whose job that is.
  • The shared kitchen and lunch terrace at the head of the stair comes with it.

A studio of your own,
and the floor when you need it.

The studio is €600 a month, everything in.
The floor below is yours at €35 an hour,
whatever the size, the same price every day of the week,
plus a cleaning fee per booking of €25 / €50 / €75 by size,
where anyone else pays €50 to €95 an hour.
Every booking counts 1 hour before and 1 after, time to set up and to put the floor back. A four-hour class bills 6 hours.

Everything in means everything:
energy, cooling, heating, wifi, water, the weekly clean.
We would rather the floor were used by the people upstairs
than by strangers. You know the space, you look after it,
we don’t have to be there.
That is what the tenant price is for.

Questions

The things people ask.

Can I run my own paying workshops and events on the floor?

Yes. That is the point of the studios. Book the floor at €35 an hour and charge your own people what you like, for events you host yourself. The tenant rate is for your own workshops, classes and shows, not for re-letting: you can’t book the floor at tenant price and hire it out to someone else. If a third party wants the floor, they book it from us at the regular rates.

When is the floor free?

We run our own workshops here, in general on weekdays. Outside that it is open to book. We agree the calendar together and we stay flexible. Talk to us about the pattern you need.

What does a booking include?

The floor for your hours plus 1 hour before and 1 after, tables, chairs and the walls from the closets, the screen on the big wall, and the cleaning afterwards.

Are there machines?

No. The wood and build area downstairs is Peter’s own workshop, and the floor is a clean space. Bring hand tools and whatever fits your studio.

Can I leave things on the floor?

No. The floor is a working space, and it is cleared after every use. Your things live in your studio.

Is my studio private?

Curtains on three sides, 3 m high, and the hall’s wall behind you. Private to work in; not a locked room.

Contract, deposit, notice?

We are writing the terms now. Ask, and we will tell you exactly where we are.

Where are you in the process?

Mid-way: signing our lease, planning the build, and finding the four partners. The first conversations are happening now.
